observed_in: Pet and Companion System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the degree of player influence and management over companions, ranging from complete control to minimal or no control. Variations can include direct commands, autonomous behavior, or a mix of both.
exclusion_criteria: All companions are completely controlled by the game without player input
inclusion_criteria: Players can issue commands to companions
Companions can act independently based on their own AI
title: Companion Control Level
